source: McAuley Amazon Reviews 2023（公开研究数据集）
reviews: These filters fit my vacuum perfectly. I have a Shark NV 360. The package it came in didn't say NV 360 on it, it said a few different models, but they fit mine. I forgot how much suction my vacuum had until now! Definitely replace you filters regularly! I will be buying these again when the time comes!

Vacuum attachment arrives bent in half and it makes it ineffective. The handle comes off the brush. One review says to bake attachment to soften and then straighten but there becomes a point of ridiculous. Returning it and off to Home Depot so I can see what I am buying.

Kenmore / Sears Model No 253.52649304 Mfgd. 01-04 These door bins look identical to the cheap original ones. They are made from a different plastic in my opinion. Whether they will last a lifetime, is anyone's guess. I'm glad I was able to get a suitable replacement without getting fleeced by the mfgr. parts prices which are outrageous for a small vacuum formed plastic part.
Doesn’t seem to filter. Broadcasts a very fine white dust that sticks to plastic case of vacuum and every other surface. Suggest you buy elsewhere.

As others pointed out, the hose section is very wimpy. Long enoguh to be useful, but too flexible to be pushed any further than about a foot without curling and stopping. I could not get it to bend into the cavity exhaust pipe beyond what was visible at the entrance. The vacuum attachment is pretty good and fits well, but the hose just does not stay stiff enough to use properly. My crevice tool can cover the the same areas and takes no additional closet space.

This is the kit needed to get the drum spinning again and squeak free with the new rollers. All fit perfectly, took me about 45minutes to do this because i also took the time to vacuum out any and all lint on the interior panels. Also found a nice pile of coins and few $5 & $20 bills down there.

Its tighter than the original but it vacuums powerfully to catch more dust. I just notice tt when i empty the bin now, alot more dust has been sucked up compared to my worn original filter. Also, i find vacuuming slightly less noisy perhaps due to the tight fit of this new filter

I had been using a Cona glass rod with my Yama vacuum coffee brewer, but it was hit-or-miss as to whether it would clog or not. The Diguo works great, allows the brewed coffee to flow freely to the carafe, does not clog and is relatively easy to clean. I was somewhat hesitant to give it a try because of the negative reviews regarding coffee residue build-up, but I gave it a try anyway. It's not hard to disassemble and clean - do so shortly after brewing and it should remain residue free.
Maybe a tad too flexible, you need a little stiffness to push it through vent, but it did the job for me. You'll do better to accompany this with a vacuum.
This does not work for the bissell Featherweight vacuum series #2033 like I had hoped. It’s to small. Returned to sender, waiting on refund 😑

This is a good basic idea but has problems with actual functioning. You must take off the dryer vent cover according to your dryers maintenance book ( which is not described in the description details). Then when you put the hose down the vacuum makes a high pitched sound because the hose only has a small opened to suck the gunk our through, so the strain on your vacuum is enormous and insufficient. I am afraid such a design would ruin my vacuum so I will be sending this back to Amazon.
MKes my vacuum look new again! Love it 😊
Product is junk. No need for the long hose because it doesn’t Ben go very far in the dryer. Reaches the same as the hos on your vacuum!!
New filters kept me from having to purchase a new vacuum. The suction is back and cleans better than ever.
This is a great product it fits my vacuum perfectly and clean well too!

Our drier is old af. It’s broken down twice in the past three years and my husband was able to successfully fix it both times. Hurray for money saved. The valve coils were very simple to replace after taking off the front access panels. Since it was open we gave it a thorough vacuuming on the inside and wiped down all the parts with a damp microfiber cloth. Now we once again have a toasty hot drier that’s working perfectly well.
This product is flimsy and thin. It is leas effective than the original that came with the vacuum. It gets the job done but you will have to buy a replacement soon is you use your unit often.

I bought this to suction out my dryer vent but unfortunately the way the vent is "arranged", I was unable to navigate the hose down into it any further than using my vacuum hose. So I had to pull the dryer out from the wall and suction from the rear access. Airflow to my dryer has greatly improved since using.

My dryer has the vent trap in the front of the door. The tube is difficult to maneuver in the slot because the end that attaches to the vacuum is too wide, and it gets stuck. I hope it got the lint cleaned out.

Works in my upright vacuum and seems to be of decent quality. Actually some of these filters at brick and mortar stores are a lot more money which is why I put off replacing my filter. I should have checked Amazon sooner!
Just used this for the first time and it did about the same job as my vacuum... did not go much deeper in the vent. I've adjusted it multiple times but it keeps makes this horrific screeching noise.
I ordered because of Shark Tank. What I received was not complete. After several attempts to get the missing part, I protested the charge on my credit card.

Needed bags for my Kirby generation 5 and the local vacuum cleaner store had closed and my other store source wasn't open...found these and was amazed at the price and testimonials were high so I decided to give them a try...glad I did
Worked great, fits easily on the vacuum hose. Brought up in chu chunks what couldn't go through the thin pipe, but that's ok because it does bring it up. Worked great.
This purchase made a world of difference in my vacuum experience. It is a wonderful filter that helps improve the performance of my vacuum.

I am still wishing for a cover that doesn’t obstruct air flow significantly. Tried this one because the little flap item , we all used forever, doesn’t really open satisfactorily in the location I have.,,at the end of long pipe run …(the other end is clean by my inspection and vacuum. )

Original bearing was dried up and rusty, no wonder it was squealing! New bearing and socket installed quickly and easily with no trouble. I took the time to vacuum out all the dryer lint from the entire dryer while I had it open, and replaced the belt as well. Runs quietly and smoothly now, should be good for a long time. Much faster + easier than a new dryer or getting a repair person to come out, to say nothing of the cost.
I needed to replace the one from the vacuum after I washed it and my dog chewed it up. It's a filter, it needs to be replaced every so often. Every year or two seems to work for me.

Yes these are wonderful and I was most excited by the info given in the advertising. I always washed them and the lint never all came out. The ad suggested vacuuming and never needing to purchase these any more. It works acceptably well. Although they will probably need to be replaced eventually, they are a great replacement.
Fits great in my Shark Rocket vacuum. Love the vacuum and the filters are great and easy to wash.
I needed replacements for my handheld cordless vacuum and this are compatible and fitted very well

My vent is on the top of my dryer. I did have to attach a thin piece of coat hanger to the hose with duct tape, but I only got out a tiny amount of lint. I will have to remove the back to do a better cleaning. On a good note; which leads me to believe it was worth the money; it works great on my handheld vacuum for the car and reaches under the seat, as well as the vents very well.
Very pleased. We have a vacuum seal, but the Mylar bags were to,wide for that one. This one fit perfect. If you want a vacuum sealed package you will need to include O2 absorbers.
I ordered these filters a few days ago and they arrived today. Both look to be the standard Dyson filters. I had no issues putting the new filters in to replace the old ones.
I just bought a new Shark vacuum, so I decided to purchase extra filters. The arrived swiftly and were decently priced.

these Filters are the best choice for our townhouse, the vent pipe was installed incorrectly,so we have to use the BetterVent filter. Just have to say that it is a pain to have to vacuum the filters about every 2 -3 drying cycles, our dryer is very sensitive

If you have any experience with air purifiers at all, you know that replacement filters can sometimes be on the expensive side especially for certain brands. I'm happy to say that these filters fit my Dyson air purifiers perfectly and work just as well as the filters that came with the air purifiers. Plus these filters are alot more economical than the name brand filters. I love the cleaning brush that was included too!

Great bargain filter, but with brand name use. I have it in my Dyson TP01 and as I cant afford name brand every go around, this is great option. Of course Dyson brand is better, but on a budget this does what I need and saves me a bit for next time. Great purchase

arrived without cleaning tool, which was the entire reason why I chose this product over several otherwise identical product listings. some reviews below mentioned that the filters don't fit. I had that problem initially, too, but found that by twisting off the mesh screen around the filter, I could seat it properly. this doesn't seem to have negatively affected vacuum performance so far.
I have 2 vacuum cleaners and this doesn’t fit either one. So that part of the kit is useless to me.
